subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the documentation redirects and stack rebase are complete, should an administrator or security owner authorize removal of the temporary `qa-matrix` workspace package and lockfile importer on the resulting exact head?
rationale: Repository dependency policy blocks this intentional graph change until an authorized human confirms the exact SHA; automation cannot grant or infer that approval.

options.title: Authorize the final rebased head
options.body: Review the package deletion and approve the exact post-fix SHA so the canonical QA Lab ownership cleanup can land.

options.title: Split the package deletion
options.body: Land only the ownership and documentation consolidation, then remove the package and lockfile importer in a separately authorized administrator-owned follow-up.

recommendation.title: Authorize the final rebased head
recommendation.body: Review the package deletion and approve the exact post-fix SHA so the canonical QA Lab ownership cleanup can land.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision requires repository-admin or security authority, and recent history also connects this owner to QA Lab maintenance.
